introduction: The IT SBA is a project divided into three main components: Word Processing, Spreadsheets, and Database Management, plus a Problem-Solving (Program) component. It counts for 25% of the total grade.

tasks.title: Document Creation
tasks.explanation: Create letters, flyers, and tables using advanced formatting.

tasks.title: Data Analysis
tasks.explanation: Use formulas, functions, and charts to analyze data.

tasks.title: Data Management
tasks.explanation: Create tables, queries, forms, and reports.

tasks.title: Programming
tasks.explanation: Create an algorithm (pseudocode/flowchart) and a Pascal program.

sampleTitle: A management system for 'Bayview Sports Club' memberships and tournament scheduling.

sample.body: The club currently uses a paper-based system which is inefficient for tracking 200 members and their fees. This project designs a digital system to automate fee tracking and generate monthly reports.
sample.tips: Identify the limitations of the current manual system.

sample.body:
Table: Members (MemberID, Name, JoinedDate, MembershipType)
Table: Payments (PaymentID, MemberID, Amount, Date)
sample.tips: Ensure primary and foreign keys are clearly identified.

marking: Successful integration of the three components and a logical, error-free program are the main criteria.
